page.layout: One page of running text in one column; marginal notes in the right margin, beside the lines they stand by. Running head at top. Page number at top right. No notes under the text, no catchword, no signature.

main_text.p: esse rationis cur rem isto modo in dubium vocaret, quod {a}quidamGraeci, & Hieronymus, Patres velint omni peccato vacare Petri factum, {b}quidamTertullianus, vero nolint. Nam ad hos, qui nolunt, adjungit suum calculum, non dico, Villavincentius, aut, Censores Belgici; quorum {c}hiCyprianus, subscribunt {d}BezaeAmbrosius, Augustinus, Gregorius Romanus & alii non-nulli. affirmanti Petrum peccasse; {e}ille peccatum gravius exagge-gerat quam Magdeburgenses: sed {f}AquinasInd.expurg. in Nov. Test. ipse, quem scriptoribus cunctis, exceptis Canonicis, praeponit {g}InnocentiusSyr.Gr.Lat., Pontifex Romanus. Atque, quum in ejus operibus Romae editis alia {h}nonnullaedit.cumverf. ex Syr. per Imm. Trem. de mandato Pii Quinti sublata sint: hoc ibi approbatur, quod Petrus ex humana fragilitate peccasse dicitur, atque in crimen publicum incurrisse; & {i}timuisseAnnot. minorib. inepist. ad Gal. cap.2. ver.12. inordinate, quia veritas nunquam dimittenda est propter timorem scandali; nec levem occasionem reprehensionis Paulo praebuis-se, sed iustam, & utilem, scilicet periculum Evangelica veritatis.
Proinde Magdeburgenses hoc e-tiam inter Petri naevos & lapsus merito recensent.In epist. ad Gal. cap.2. lect.3.

Ita Bellarminus, dum {g}e quatuordecim horrendisSermon. Ecce plus quam Salomon hic. Tab. aur. in oper. D. Thom. Aquin. mendaciis, horribilibusque in Petrum blasphe-miis, quarum arguit Magdeburgenses, ne unius quidem eos convincit: quatuordecim horrendo-rum mendaciorum, & horribilium, si non blas-phemiarum, at calumniarum notas stigmataque inurit sibi ipsi.Praefat. ad pium lectorem.

18 Minori labe se commaculat in iis quae subdit de Paulo, quia pauciores blasphemias iis impingit. Nam, Apostolum, inquit, Paulum reprehendunt, quod in Asia supra modum gravatus de vita desperaverit: quodque in gratiam Iacobi Iudai-cas ceremonias Hierosolymis observaverit, & eo factoGal.2.21.

page.notes: Right margin notes are placed beside the nearest text lines, as the scan shows; their pairing with the superscript marks in the text is uncertain for several entries (the margin letters a-l are only partly legible, and the note letter for "ille" (e) and for the Villavincentius/Belgici note is not clearly printed). The mark for "Innocentius" is a symbol in print that I rendered as g; the mark before "horrendis" may be a different sign. Several margin notes ("Annot.", "Villavincent.", "Sermon.", "Praefat.") may be attached to other marks than shown. The left edge of the scan is partly shadowed; the first paragraph's line-ends are read from the image. Word "isto" is read as printed with long s. "Evangelica" and "praebuisse" follow the print. Greek and Hebrew: none on this page. Show-through at the top left (faint letters behind the running head) is omitted.
